name: Ashen Longsword
description: A weathered longsword said to have been carried by a knight who guarded a forgotten shrine.

name: Gravewarden Axe
description: A heavy iron axe decorated with faded runes from an ancient burial ground.

name: Moonlit Falchion
description: A curved blade with a pale edge that seems to shimmer beneath the night sky.

name: Thornwood Spear
description: A hunting spear reinforced with dark thornwood and bound in old leather.

name: Emberglass Dagger
description: A slender dagger forged from red-black glass that remains warm to the touch.

name: Ravenbone Bow
description: A short bow carved from blackened bone and strung with braided beast sinew.

name: Frostfeather Crossbow
description: A compact crossbow decorated with silver feathers and frost-blue metal.

name: Ironroot Shield
description: A round wooden shield reinforced with iron bands and roots hardened like steel.

name: Crown of the Hollow King
description: A cracked iron crown that once belonged to a ruler whose kingdom vanished into mist.

name: Wolfhide Cuirass
description: A rugged leather chest piece made from the hides of enormous northern wolves.

name: Grave-Silk Robe
description: A dark ceremonial robe woven from unusually strong silk found in an ancient crypt.

name: Stonebound Gauntlets
description: Massive iron gauntlets engraved with symbols of endurance and protection.

name: Mourning Helm
description: A battered steel helmet with a narrow visor and a black funeral veil.

name: Wyrmscale Boots
description: Light boots covered in overlapping scales taken from a small drake.

name: Crimson Flask
description: A sealed glass flask containing a bitter red tonic favored by wandering warriors.

name: Tears of the Moon
description: A rare silver-blue potion said to restore strength after a long journey.

name: Sagefire Incense
description: A bundle of fragrant herbs that burns with a faint green flame.

name: Rune of the Lost Path
description: A small stone rune believed to reveal hidden passages to those who understand its markings.

name: Lantern of Distant Stars
description: An ornate brass lantern whose pale light never seems to run out.

name: Blacksmith's Talisman
description: A worn iron charm said to bring luck when repairing weapons and armor.
